prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1484
Claimant:
Nathaniel Fleming
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
08/30/2023
First notice of loss received for a side impact at an intersection, with the insured's vehicle struck on the driver's side
by a second vehicle that entered on a red signal. The claimant has retained counsel, and all further contact is being
routed through the attorney's office.
09/29/2023
Reviewed the policy declarations and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at
the time of loss. Nothing in the underwriting file suggests the vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
10/17/2023
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the driver's seat and notes the other vehicle's failure to yield.
Responding officers and a bystander confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene.
11/21/2023
Reviewed the scene photographs, which confirm the point of impact and the general position of both vehicles. No
independent witnesses have been identified beyond the officers and the bystander who gave a brief statement at the
scene.
12/11/2023
Inspected the insured vehicle and found door panel crush and intrusion along the driver's side, consistent with the
described impact. No prior damage to the vehicle has been identified in our records or in the repair history provided.
12/12/2023
Claimant reports neck pain beginning the day of the collision, described as a strain that limits rotation. Medical
records from the initial visit document the complaint and the findings are consistent with the force and direction of the
crash. No prior injury to the neck or upper back has been identified in the medical history.
12/22/2023
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who confirmed the treatment plan. The claimant's account of the collision has
been the same in every conversation, including the recorded statement, the iniital interview, and the written
submission.
01/15/2024
Reviewed the treatment records, which show a usual course of physical therapy and follow-up visits. Symptoms have
improved steadily and the frequency of visits has tapered as the claimant's range of motion recovered.
02/07/2024
Evaluated the injury against the mechanism of loss. The reported neck strain fits the kind and force of a side impact of
this type, and the medical reviewer agreed the treatment is reasonable for the diagnosis.
03/10/2024
Current status is that the claim remains open pending the final treatment summary and the attorney's demand
package. No further coverage questions are outstanding, and the file is being prepared for evaluation of the bodily
injury component.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
